features.description: Add a cycle-safe `case *types.TRecord` to formatTypeCanonical so record types render as {label: type, ...} instead of leaking <*types.TRecord>. Shared by all exported function signatures.
acceptance_criteria: A record-returning exported function renders {...}, not <*types.TRecord>
A recursive-record type renders without hanging (bounded via visited/depth guard)
Open/row-polymorphic records render known labels + an explicit open-row marker
features.notes: Implemented + verified on docparse/types/document.ail (leak count 0); 7 new tests pass
